name: User Login
description: Register accounts with an email address, sign in and view the signed-in profile
backend_requirements: Access control: anyone may register and sign in; require auth for reading the own profile; admin endpoints are restricted to the admin account
POST /api/auth/register creates an account from email, password and an optional display_name; it answers 201 with the new account

Registration validation: email is required, at most 254 characters and of the form name@domain with a dot in the domain; it is stored in lower case and must be unique ignoring case (a second registration answers 409); password is at least 8 and at most 128 characters; display_name, when given, is at most 50 characters

POST /api/auth/login takes email (matched ignoring case) and password and answers 200 with a top-level token, token_type "bearer" and the account; a wrong email or password answers 401, and a deactivated account answers 403
A token is sent as Authorization: Bearer <token> and stays valid for 24 hours; GET /api/auth/me answers 401 without a valid token and returns the signed-in account otherwise
The admin account has is_admin true; every other account has is_admin false
Deactivated accounts (is_active false) cannot sign in, and requests carrying their tokens answer 401; the admin overview still lists them, and the admin cannot deactivate its own account (400)

Errors answer with a JSON object {"detail": "<message>"}: 400 for invalid input, 401 for a failed sign-in or a missing or invalid token, 403 for a deactivated account or a non-admin on admin endpoints, 404 for unknown ids, 409 for an email that is already registered
frontend_requirements: Visitors see a card with 'Sign in' and 'Register' tabs; after signing in the card is replaced by the signed-in profile

Register form: email, password, password confirmation and optional display name; check required fields, email format, the 8-character password minimum and matching confirmation before sending, and show the API's message (for example an already registered email) under the form
Sign-in form: email and password; show the API's error message on failure and keep the token for later requests on success

Signed-in view: a banner with the display name (or the email when there is none), a profile panel filled from /api/auth/me with email and member-since date, and a 'Sign out' button that discards the token and returns to the sign-in card
When a request answers 401 (for example an expired token), discard the token and show the sign-in card with a 'Please sign in again' message
admin_requirements: Admin overview: every account, newest first, with email, display name, admin flag, active status and creation date, plus total, active and inactive counts
Toggle an account's active status from the overview; the button is disabled on the admin's own row

api_endpoints.description: Sign in and receive a bearer token

data_models.name: User
data_models.description: An account that signs in with its email address

fields.email: string (required, max 254 chars, stored in lower case, unique)
fields.is_admin: boolean (default false; true only for the admin account)
fields.is_active: boolean (default true; false blocks sign-in and rejects the account's tokens)

admin_api_endpoints.description: Admin overview: every account, newest first, with counts
Flip an account's active status (not allowed on the admin's own account)
